name: Ace Hanei
address: Plot No. GH-02B, Sector 12, Noida Extension, Uttar Pradesh 201318
description: Ace Hanei is an upcoming, ultra-luxury residential landmark in Sector 12, Noida Extension, featuring exceptionally large apartments, neoclassical architecture, and a 100% car-free ground podium layout.
long_description: Ace Hanei represents the pinnacle of luxury living introduced by the renowned ACE Group in Sector 12, Greater Noida West. Spread across a sprawling 6.42 acres, the project features 6 or 7 majestic high-rise towers soaring G+25 floors. Constructed using advanced Mivan/Korean aluminum shuttering technology, the development is engineered for extreme structural durability, clean alignment, and earthquake resistance. Each tower is designed with strict low-density specifications, offering only two premium corner apartments per floor, ensuring 270-degree panoramic green views, maximum daylight optimization, and seamless ventilation. Residents enjoy an elite private lifestyle with high-speed lift cores (4 lifts serving just 2 apartments per floor), private entrance vestibules, pre-fitted VRF air conditioning, modular kitchens, and polished imported Italian marble. Just minutes from major transit pathways, the project boasts an expansive 40,000 sqft central clubhouse, multi-level basement parking, and a zero-vehicle ground podium ensuring child safety and peace of mind.

builder.name: ACE Group
builder.company_overview: ACE Group is an elite, multi-award-winning real estate developer established in 2010. Headquartered in Noida, the builder has developed a formidable reputation across Delhi-NCR for top-tier residential townships and premium commercial complexes. Renowned for delivering high-end construction quality, modern architectural design, and timely hanovers, the builder has successfully delivered over 10 landmark projects covering over 15 million sqft.
